SELECT BS.SCENE_NODE_ID id,
(case when BS.FSCENE_NODEID = NULL then #{fNodeId} else IFNULL(BT.TABLE_NAME, SDL.ITEM_VALUE) end) AS text, "LEVEL" as col FROM BOK_SCENECONFIG BS LEFT JOIN BOK_TABLELIST BT ON BS.NODE_VALUE = BT.TABLE_ID and BS.NODE_ID = 'ACCOUNTEVENTS' LEFT JOIN BOK_TABLEDICT BTD ON BS.NODE_ID = BTD.DICT_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST SDL ON SDL.DICT_CODE = BTD.DICT_SOURCE AND SDL.ITEM_CODE = BS.NODE_VALUE WHERE BS.SCENE_NODE_ID = #{sceneNodeId} ORDER BY BS.SCENE_NODE_ID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT
1 AS isExtends,
(case when BSS.SCENE_NODE_ID = #{sceneNodeId} then 0 else 1 end) AS isExtends,
BSS.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectId, concat_ws('',BSU.SUBJECT_NAME ,'（',BSU.SUBJECT_NO,'）') AS subjectName, BSS.FORM_ELE AS formEle, BT.DICT_NAME AS dictName, BSS.CD_FLAG cdFlag, BSS.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, BSS.ACCOUNT_NET accountNet FROM BOK_SCENESUBJECT BSS LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT BSU ON BSS.SUBJECT_NO = BSU.SUBJECT_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_TABLEDICT BT ON BT.DICT_ID = BSS.FORM_ELE AND BT.DICT_TYPE = #{DATA_TYPEN} WHERE INSTR(#{sceneNodeId}, BSS.SCENE_NODE_ID) = 1 ) ORDER BY isExtends DESC

SELECT SUBJECT_NO AS id, concat_ws('',SUBJECT_NAME,'（',SUBJECT_NO,'）' )AS text, BAL_FLAG AS col, SUBJECT_TYPE AS parentId FROM BOK_SUBJECT BS1 WHERE BS1.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BOK_SUBJECT BS WHERE BS.FSUBJECT_ID = BS1.SUBJECT_NO )

SELECT (case when MAX_SCENE_NODE_ID = NULL then 1 else CAST( MAX_SCENE_NODE_ID ) + 1 end) FROM ( SELECT SUBSTRING( MAX( SCENE_NODE_ID ), LENGTH( FSCENE_NODEID ) + 1 ) FROM BOK_SCENECONFIG WHERE 1 = 1
AND FSCENE_NODEID = #{fsceneNodeid}
AND FSCENE_NODEID is null
GROUP BY FSCENE_NODEID ) MAX_SCENE_NODE_ID
